_comment: CVLX CHILD MOUNT — the LIFEPUNCH/s&box domain layer. Every s&box-specific name lives HERE, never in the parent (mragerlp/cavelux). The parent ships only the generic upstream-mount mechanism and consumes this file via CAVELUX_UPSTREAM_CONFIG. BOUNDARY LAW: if a name in this file ever appears in the parent repo, the boundary is broken.
_ruling: dispatch/red/0015 (Bloodwave GO 2026-07-21T02:33-04:00): native-only. NO chomnr (9090), NO sboxclaude-stdio (redundant with native), NO Ozmium (convar debris, excluded), NO vanilla (dirty tree; canonical is the clean one per red/0014).

sbox-native.name: s&box native MCP (gateway)
sbox-native.description: The s&box editor's native MCP endpoint. A 7-tool GATEWAY over a live 284-tool / 35-toolset registry that includes the full 28-toolset sboxclaude bridge family (262 tools, incl. the lpbitcoin-UI 82-subset), published by the sboxskinsgg.claudebridge editor lib. Mounting the gateway costs the tool cap 7 — the rest is reached BY NAME through search_tools/describe_toolset/call_tool. Verified live on canonical dxrp\game (red/0014). No auth: bare localhost, no credential — nothing secret is tracked here.

entry_tools.name: call_tool
entry_tools.description: Invoke ONE registry tool by name. This is how the whole 284-tool registry is reached at 7-tool cap cost.

entry_tools.name: call_tools
entry_tools.description: Invoke several registry tools in one round trip.

entry_tools.name: search_tools
entry_tools.description: Find registry tools by keyword — the guess-free entry point. Search BEFORE calling; never invent a tool name.

entry_tools.name: describe_toolset
entry_tools.description: Describe one toolset and its tools — read the real signature before calling.

entry_tools.name: editor_status
entry_tools.description: Editor/session status: ProjectRoot, engine version, ToolCount.

entry_tools.name: read_console
entry_tools.description: Read the editor console — the compile/runtime sensor.

identity_guard._why: PROJECT-IDENTITY GUARD (Codex's guard, dispatch/red/0015 step 1). The mount selects a URL, not a tree — which project the :7269 editor has OPEN is what decides what these tools operate on. Refuse rather than silently edit the wrong project.

lanes._comment: Child-owned lanes, merged over the parent's built-ins. lpbitcoin-ui is LEAN by design: the gateway plus the parent's universal UI intelligence — and ZERO parent eye tools, so the whole lane costs exactly the 7 gateway tools.
